title: Handloom Saree Weaving Pattern Inspector
problem: Women weavers in our street work long hours on handlooms, but master weavers cut their wage if tiny thread breaks go unnoticed.
idea: A weave checker. The weaver shows a part of the saree to the camera, and it says if the pattern is perfect or has a broken thread, so she can fix it early. Here you can tap what the camera sees.

widgets.heading: 🎯 Try it: What does the camera see on the loom?
widgets.intro: In my real project, Teachable Machine compares the cloth with photos of good and faulty weaving. Here, tap what the camera sees.
widgets.question: The camera looks at this part of the saree:

options.label: Broken thread line
options.result: Broken thread found! Stop and tie the thread before weaving more.
options.te: దారం తెగింది! ఇంకా నేసే ముందు దారం ముడి వేయండి.

options.label: Loose or uneven area
options.result: Weave looks loose here. Check the tension of the threads.
options.te: ఇక్కడ నేత వదులుగా ఉంది. దారాల బిగువు చూడండి.

items.title: Check every hour
items.text: Look at the woven part every hour, not only at the end.
items.te: చివర్లో కాదు, ప్రతి గంటకు నేసిన భాగం చూడండి.

items.title: Good light
items.text: Weave near a window or bright bulb so small faults are easy to see.
items.te: కిటికీ దగ్గర లేదా మంచి వెలుతురులో నేయండి.

items.title: Rest your eyes
items.text: Look far away for one minute every 30 minutes.
items.te: ప్రతి 30 నిమిషాలకు ఒక నిమిషం దూరంగా చూడండి.

items.title: Keep photos
items.text: Take a photo of good work. It is proof if there is a wage argument.
items.te: మంచి పని ఫోటో తీసి పెట్టుకోండి. కూలీ గొడవలో సాక్ష్యంగా పనికొస్తుంది.

how: Ask a weaver aunty to show me good saree parts and parts with broken threads.
Open Teachable Machine, choose Image Project and make 3 classes: Good weave, Broken thread, Loose weave.
Take about 40 close-up photos for each class in good light.
Train the model, test it on a new saree, then Export and copy the link.
In PictoBlox, add the ML extension, paste the link and make the sprite say a warning in Telugu when a broken thread is seen.
Ask Gemini for simple eye-care and checking tips for weavers.
prompt: I am a Class 8 student helping handloom weavers in my street. Give 5 simple tips to find and fix broken threads early while weaving a saree, and 2 eye-care tips. Use simple English and simple Telugu.
